description: This file defines a mock class MessageDispatcherMock for unit testing, which inherits from IMessageDispatcher and uses Google Mock to mock the createClient method. It is used to simulate the behavior of a message dispatcher in tests.

classes.name: MessageDispatcherMock
classes.description: A mock class for IMessageDispatcher used in testing, providing a mocked createClient method.
